divergence: Mixed (T0 passes; T1 and T2 fail). All runs tried store-wide extraction scans that timed out. T0 fell back on a file-name search for financing document types, read offering and credit documents from 13 matters and found the term-loan matter's executed agreement and post-closing letter. T1 never reached that matter: its scans covered 34 matters, and it moved to reading after the reconciliation review specifically asked it to scan the 232 missing ones. T2 completed a scan, but the large-amount filter it chose candidates from was cut at 100 lines (the review named the cut), and it answered with a larger multi-billion facility from another matter, which the precision criterion accepts but the main criterion does not. So the runs split at the search stages (T1 search-miss, T2 over-narrow filter), and in both failing runs a specific review flag was ignored. The agent-defined stages were rescans, listings and reads; T2's three post-write cross-checks used a threshold above the expected matter's amount.
